docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Strachey’s English translation of the Bījagaṇita of Bhāskara (1150), the Hindu algebra with its rules for the unknown, the pulverizer and the equations of the second degree (London, 1813). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Wellesley College Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Bija ganita, or, The algebra of the Hindus · Bhaskaracarya, b. 1114, Strachey, Edward, Sir, 1812-1901 · 1813, 562 scanned pages. Published 1813; Edward Strachey died before 1901; Bhāskara lived in the twelfth century; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
